title: [eBay Plus, Box Damaged] Dyson V8 Cyclone + Hair Screw Tool $319.20 Delivered @ Dyson eBay
body:
Deal: [eBay Plus, Box Damaged] Dyson V8 Cyclone + Hair Screw Tool $319.20 Delivered @ Dyson eBay

[skibidigrimacmoggr67] the hair screw tool is one of the best tool.
[max25well] this or V8 advanced with car cleaning kit at 349?
[kongkurr] I haven't tried the advanced, but went from a V7 to the V8 Cyclone recently and it's been amazing for building dust, long pet hair etc. Haven't needed to clean the head at all after a bunch of uses.
I got the Amazon ~$50 accessory kit with all the attachments you could need.
FYI 'Box damaged' generally doesn't mean anything from Dyson, you'll more than likely get perfect packaging, it's just an excuse to be able to undercut retailers.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] V8 advanced with car cleaning kit
I commented on this when it was posted as deal. https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/970366
but FYI the "Adcanced car cleaning kit" does not come with any small motorhead. ymmv. but my friend said the "mini motorhead" and "hair screw tool" (in this deal, same small size) are the best tool for vacuuming a car. the floormat and carpet areas can be finished in seconds, rather than spending many minutes scrubbing with the brush tool or narrow nozzle tool, and bumping the vacuum into the car interior.
what makes the hair screw tool better than mini motorhead? the spinning part inside is cone shaped, and the hairs fall through more easily into the bin, and any that ends up goes on one side of the motorhead where it is easily pulled off. normally the hairs just get wrap around everywhere and knotted clogging the motorhead over time.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] should mention. car cleaning car use, the hair screw and narrow nozzle tools (in additional to full size motorhead) included in this deal, are the most used tools for the car.
but for general vacuum use, I find the short brush tool (it's called "Combination" bit wider than nozzle but shorter and with brush on the end) very handy, as it disturbs dust as you vacuum daily surfaces and collect more of it.
so for house use, you will maybe want to look into buying the other Dyson's kits, or buy the accessory kit for sale, or I think you can just buy the short brush tool from dyson directly. https://www.dyson.com.au/combination-tool-967482-01 (currently OOS)
I think I saw the accessory kit as low as ~$35 on sale at TGG with price beat button. or buy the cheap chinese clone Combination tool for half on amazon.
[atlas] Hmmmm this or a Dreame Z10 with auto empty station?
[Davo81] Just picked up the dreame from target this week. Its seriously impressive for 279! Build quality is top notch suction is impressive and the self cleaning station works so well.
I did read the battery capacity could be better, but I do the entire upstairs 3 bed and landing on full and then downstairs rugs on medium and hard floors on low. 20 mins of vaccuuming and it's down to 65%. replacement batteries are available on AliExpress for $65 and they just slide on.
Comes with two motorised heads (one with led), one motorised upholstery head, and 2 stick/brush attachments.
Overall seriously impressed after the first week of ownership.
[xxJAGUARxx] Why is the v8 always on sale and not discontinued? I tried the v15 and its very top heavy and hurts the wrists. Is v8 the best of the best?
[Dollar Dreamer] The V8 is made for females and it weighs less but also has less performance. The V15 is designed as a man vacuum cleaner with better performance but is heavier and more cumbersome to use. It is long with awkward weight distribution and a bit more heavier which will not suit females doing house cleaning. In my house only the men and boys do the vacuuming because the females said no.
[ardvrk102] Does anyone think there will be battery adapters for the V8 Cyclone in the future like other Dyson models?
I'm assuming it's a somewhat new model and they haven't had time to convert it yet.
[fruitloafer] no because it seems the V8 cyclone is now using 7 batteries for a 25 volts total voltage.this makes it pretty much unusable in being powered by a 18v power tool battery.
stick with the standard V8 if you want to convert it to power tool 18v batteries
